adrian (Eng Manager): Heads up: we've got a high-perf IC approved to move L3 -> L4. Manager set effective date back to Jan 15 (more than 30 days). What steps for backpay and docs needed?

kate (People Ops): Thx. Since effective date is >30 days retro, you'll need a backpay approval flow. Basic checklist: leveling form, manager justification, peer/skip notes, target comp recommendation, requested effective date, and explicit backpay ask with months_retro.

nina (Compensation): Confirming: comp will review manager note + target and calculate proposed backpay estimate. We'll need the old and proposed annual salary numbers. Please upload to the secure leveling portal and set "backpay=yes".

adrian (Eng Manager): Do I include spreadsheets with per-pay-period calc or will Comp/Payroll handle that?

nina (Compensation): Helpful but not required. Provide old_annual_salary, new_annual_salary, and effective_date. Comp will compute gross backpay; Payroll will finalize net after tax. If you want a modeling spreadsheet, attach it but redact PII.

lucy (Payroll): For payroll processing we need employee ID (secure form), paycode PROMO_BP, lump_sum vs recurring flag, tax withholding instruction, and whether to spread over N pay cycles. Standard is lump_sum unless manager requests spread. Note payroll cannot change effective date; we follow the approved effective date from Comp/People Ops.

adrian (Eng Manager): For approvals: who signs the backpay?

kate (People Ops): Approval chain: Manager -> Compensation -> Finance partner -> People Ops director sign-off for exceptions over thresholds (e.g., >$10k). We'll route automatically once comp approves. Expect comp triage ~3 business days.

adrian (Eng Manager): Any exec escalation flags?

nina (Compensation): Flags: >20% comp increase, any inequitable delta compared to band, >$Xk lump-sum (we use $10k), or unusual equity combos. We'll mark and route to director/GC as needed.

payroll-bot: Reminder: never post SSNs, bank details, or full DOBs in channel. Use https://redwood/payroll/secure to submit employee IDs and docs.

adrian (Eng Manager): I'll upload manager justification and the salary numbers now and mark 'backpay=Y'.

kate (People Ops): Received the upload. @nina starting comp review. I'll create a finance ticket once comp signs off. I'll also add an escalation contact list in the ticket.

nina (Compensation): Quick FYI on calc snippet we use: Backpay_gross = (new_annual - old_annual) / 12 * months_retro. If old salary had special allowances, note them.

lucy (Payroll): Once Finance approves, we'll process lump-sum in the next payroll + 1 cycle. If spread is requested, give number of cycles now. We'll include standard supplemental withholding unless employee elects alternate withholding via secure portal.

adrian (Eng Manager): Appreciate the clarity. Timeline look?

kate (People Ops): Comp 3bd, Finance 2bd, Payroll execution next pay run +1. If urgent, mark expedite and include budget owner.

adrian (Eng Manager): Marked expedite and added budget owner. Thanks all.

kate (People Ops): Final checklist posted in leveling templates: 1) leveling form, 2) manager justification (<200 words), 3) peer notes, 4) comp target, 5) backpay request if >30d, 6) comp -> finance -> payroll routing, 7) escalation contacts. I'll close thread when payroll confirms execution. :thumbsup:
